repos_data.description: Sextant is a local Python Financial Backtest app with a Streamlit interface. The core is a strict bar-by-bar event loop (MarketEvent → SignalEvent → OrderEvent → FillEvent) — fully deterministic, with a complete JSON audit trail of every event.
TypeScript/JavaScript SDK and the ot CLI for outcometick — write a strategy, check it locally, and run it against real archived prediction-market data in a sandbox.
